words.def: estimated time of arrival — when something or someone is expected to arrive.
words.book: TBD: to be determined · ETA: estimated time of arrival · ETD: estimated time of departure
uses: Email
Could you share the ETA for the 40 kVA UPS units ordered under PO 2231?
Chat
what's the ETA on the batteries? client keeps calling 😅
Meeting
The shipment is at the port; ETA to our warehouse is Thursday.
doo: What's the ETA on the batteries?

words.def: to be confirmed — planned, but not final yet.
words.book: ROI: return on investment · SOP: standard operating procedure · TBA: to be announced · TBC: to be confirmed
uses: Email
Site visit: Tuesday, 10 a.m. (TBC by the customer).
Chat
training date is TBC, will update you
Meeting
The handover date is still TBC — it depends on the civil works.
dont: The date is not sure yet, maybe.

words.def: according to — used to refer to an agreement, request or document.
words.book: Providing support or evidence: according to · as stated by · based on · as per
uses: Email
As per the maintenance contract, preventive visits are carried out every quarter.
Chat
as per our call, sending the revised quote now
Meeting
As per the SOP, the load must be on bypass before we replace the batteries.
dont: According on the contract, the visit is every 3 months.
doo: As per the contract, visits are quarterly.

words.def: only if a certain condition is met.
words.book: Conditional or hypothetical situations: if · unless · provided that · in case · otherwise
uses: Email
We can deliver by the end of the month, provided that the advance payment is received this week.
Chat
we can go tomorrow provided that site access is ok
Meeting
The warranty is valid provided that the units are installed by our engineers.
goes: provided that the conditions are met
dont: We will deliver with condition you pay first.
doo: We will deliver provided that the advance payment is received.

words.def: as a result of what was just mentioned.
words.book: Showing cause and effect: due to · because · consequently · therefore · as a result
uses: Email
The inverter supplier delayed the shipment; consequently, commissioning has moved to 15 May.
Chat
battery bank failed, consequently the whole server room went down 😬
Meeting
Fuel prices went up; consequently, our transport costs increased by 10%.
dont: The shipment delayed, so for that the project delayed.
doo: The shipment was delayed; consequently, the project was delayed.

words.def: especially — used to point out an important example.
words.book: Indicating importance: significantly · notably · essentially · above all
uses: Email
Service revenue grew this year, notably in solar maintenance contracts.
Chat
sales were up everywhere, notably Alex 🔥
Meeting
Several clients, notably the two hospitals, renewed their contracts early.

upgrade.plain: I send you this mail to inform you the batteries arrived.
upgrade.ar: ببعتلك الميل ده عشان أبلغك إن البطاريات وصلت
pro: I send you this mail to inform you the batteries arrived.
I'm pleased to let you know that the batteries have arrived.
I inform you by this mail that batteries reached.
upgrade.why: ادخل في الموضوع على طول: ‎let you know that‎ أكتر طبيعية من الترجمة الحرفية.

pro: I look forward to hearing from you.
I am waiting for your reply fastly.
upgrade.why: ‎waiting your reply‎ ناقصها ‎for‎ وتبان زنّ. الختام المهني ‎I look forward to hearing from you‎.

upgrade.plain: Please send me the report today before you go home.
upgrade.ar: ابعتلي التقرير النهارده قبل ما تروّح
pro: Please send me the report today before you go to your house.
Send the report today before home.
Please send me the report by EOD.
upgrade.why: ‎EOD‎ = آخر اليوم، اختصار معروف وقصير في الشغل.

upgrade.plain: Please confirm you took my mail.
pro: Please confirm you took my mail.
Could you please confirm that you've received this message?

upgrade.plain: The price will change because of this the dollar went up.
upgrade.ar: السعر هيتغير بسبب إن الدولار زاد
pro: Due to the rise in the exchange rate, prices will be revised.
Because of this the dollar went up, price change.
The price will change due to the dollar is up.
upgrade.why: ‎due to‎ بعدها اسم (‎the rise‎) مش جملة كاملة.

upgrade.plain: Also, in addition, the warranty is 2 years also.
pro: Also in addition the warranty also is 2 years.
In addition, the warranty covers two years.
upgrade.why: كلمة ربط واحدة كفاية؛ ماتكررش ‎also‎ و ‎in addition‎ مع بعض.
